title: Ohio Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & How to File
rank_math_title: Ohio Small Claims Court (2026): $6,000 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: Ohio small claims in 2026: $6,000 limit, local filing fees ($92 in Franklin County), no assignees, magistrate hearings, 14-day objections and 7% interest.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> right municipal/county court -> complaint (exact legal name) -> fee + service -> counterclaim deadline (7 days before trial) -> magistrate hearing -> 14-day objections -> 30-day appeal -> collection (debtor exam, garnishment, certificate of judgment)
Box: what small claims can't hear (assignees, libel/slander, replevin, punitive damages)
featured_image_prompt: Ohio municipal courthouse exterior on a crisp autumn morning, a folder of receipts and a pen on a bench in the foreground, navy and crimson accents, editorial photo style, no text

inline_images.prompt: horizontal timeline: complaint, certified mail service, counterclaim 7 days before trial, magistrate hearing, 14-day objections, 30-day appeal, navy/crimson on cream

editor_notes: Fees are Franklin County Municipal Court (fcmcclerk.com cost schedule). If you add Cleveland/Cincinnati figures, confirm on those clerk sites. Interest: 7% is for 2026 judgments; update in January 2027. The 7% (2026) and 8% (2025) figures were read from tax.ohio.gov's 'Annual Certified Interest Rates' page, which returns HTTP 404 to automated checks; the Hamilton County Clerk page is linked instead.
